rules.accepted_credit_types: No Board pre-approval; courses sponsored, certified or approved by a recognized health-related organization, professional association or state (courses approved by another state or another Oregon health licensing board are accepted). Minimum course length 0.5 hour; online unlimited. Clinical: general CC (no limit), CPR/BLS max 1, clinical instructor 1 CC per 40 h (max 8, Board-approved CI certification needed), ABPTRFE residency/fellowship up to 24, presenting and publications max one-third of the requirement (usually 8). Non-clinical (committee work with OBPT/OPTA/APTA/FSBPT, business/leadership, self-care, jurisprudence/ethics) max 8 total, max 4 per category; OR-JAM once per period = 3 CC.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Prorated by license effective date: effective Jan 1 - Mar 31 of the even (renewal) year: no CC; Apr 1 - Dec 31 of the preceding odd year: 12 hours (presenting/publications max 4 each); earlier: 24 hours. Those licensed after April 1, 2024 took the pain module at application but must still enter it at renewal.
rules.audit_note: CC activities are entered in the licensee portal and certificates uploaded with the renewal application (certificate must show licensee name, course title, hours, completion date, speaker/sponsor); the license is not renewed until CC is documented.

topics.who: Oregon Pain Management Commission module (currently 'Transforming Pain Management', free) at every renewal (ORS 413.590); no alternative course accepted
At least 1 hour each certification period; courses on the OBPT list or meeting OHA criteria

rules.notes: Certification period April 1 of an even year - March 31 of the next even year (current: Apr 1, 2026 - Mar 31, 2028); licenses expire March 31 of even years. Renewal fee shown is the base fee (plus a verification and processing fee and the $8 OHA workforce survey fee). Required courses count toward the 24 hours.
